greeting.speaker: Grandpa
greeting.text: Oh... you're half-dead too. Thank you for the water. I have a little food in the kitchen - please, eat some.

skip_to_quest.speaker: Grandpa
skip_to_quest.text: Eh. The shaking, blasts. Lights gone. Water gone. Everyone... They left. I stayed. Locked the door. Fucking TV not worked. [Crying.]

quest_assignment.speaker: Grandpa
quest_assignment.text: Could you... do something for me, son? I had a friend - far entrance. Could you check on him? ...Maybe ask him for a few cigarettes for me.
